evidence.decision: Chooses few useful background/windowless commands and resolves existing versus new/stale window targets instead of mirroring editor commands.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a state-to-command/window mapping or implemented Dock actions with equivalent visible/main-menu access.
evidence.transformation: Notes app replaces twenty inert editor commands with New Note and a small current/recent window list that resolves identity correctly.
evidence.verification: Checks background/no-window/existing/stale-item states and fails no-op commands, duplicated lost context or Dock-only custom features.
evidence.applicability: Mac-only component is explicit; mobile adaptation evaluates Quick actions rather than assuming another platform has Dock-menu parity.
evidence.handoffs: Hands alternate access to The menu bar, window identity to Windows and mobile entrypoints to Quick actions.
evidence.distinctiveness: Useful operation before the app is frontmost and stale recent-window resolution define this procedure.
